features.name: Unlimited Bip Crew with accepted-connection identity privacy
acceptanceCriteria: Bip Crew and Crew check-in sharing contain no numeric member or recipient cap while recipient lists remain deduplicated and atomic.
Accounts remain anonymous outside accepted Crew; pending, blocked, removed, self, and stranger accounts cannot receive private display identity.
Invite acceptance is permanent-account and server controlled, ignores caller-supplied identity, rejects self and blocked relationships, and creates one durable relationship per owner/member pair.
Every Crew check-in recipient must be accepted and non-blocked, and one invalid recipient rolls back the complete check-in and share operation.
Either participant may leave or block, immediately revoking trusted identity, active check-in shares, and legacy membership access.

verification.blocker: Exact-head CI, two-account anonymous-to-accepted identity proof, more-than-fifteen-member fixture proof, more-than-ten-recipient atomic sharing proof, invalid-recipient rollback proof, and iOS/Android long-list accessibility QA remain before verified status.

features.rollback: Revert the app merge and apply reviewed follow-up migrations to restore the prior max_members constraint and trigger only if product policy reverses. Preserve relationship rows and audit-safe status history; do not re-expose caller-supplied names.
